priorStatuses.title: Parse the cached payload instead of the wrapper

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant scope in document lookups
findings.body: `getDocument` no longer passes `ctx.tenantId`, so the database query matches only `documentId`. In a multi-tenant database, requesting another tenant’s known ID—or using an ID shared across tenants—can return that tenant’s document, causing cross-tenant data exposure.
